title: Project Infinity — An open-source AI DM that runs D&D 5e by the book: real dice, real spell slots, real combat
author: Serious_Character_64
selftext:
**TL;DR:** Terminal-based solo D&D. An AI narrates like a DM, but a separate game engine (MCP server + SQLite) enforces every mechanic. The AI reads dice results — it can't invent them. Full combat, spell slot management, rest recovery, level-up, and character state. SRD 5.1 compliant. Open source.

---
[Link to the GitHub Project](https://github.com/electronistu/Project_Infinity)
---

## Features

- **Fair dice** — real RNG, not AI hallucinated. Adv/disadv, natural 1/20, crits. Every roll shown with a full breakdown.
- **Full 5e spellcasting** — spell slot tracking, upcasting, cantrip scaling at levels 5/11/17, ritual casting, scroll casting with ability checks per the DMG.
- **Turn-based combat** — initiative rolled for all combatants automatically, HP tracked across hits. Multi-target AoE: one Fireball resolves every enemy in one call, individual saves per target.
- **Combat healing** — Cure Wounds, Healing Word, Mass Cure Wounds, and all SRD healing spells work in combat, with HP capped at maximum. NPC-to-player, player-to-NPC, and NPC-to-NPC healing all supported.
- **Temporary HP and active buffs** — Shield auto-boosts AC, False Life grants THP, Mage Armor recalculates armor. Buffs auto-revert when removed.
- **Rest & recovery** — short rests spend hit dice automatically (Arcane Recovery for Wizards, Pact Magic for Warlocks). Long rests restore everything and clear active effects.
- **Automatic level-up** — XP thresholds trigger HP rolls (CON mod applied, Hill Dwarf bonus), proficiency bonus, new spell slots, and DC recalculation.
- **Persistent character** — inventory, gold, spell slots, hit dice, and reputation survive between sessions. `/save` writes your sheet to disk.
- **Persistent world** — kingdoms with rulers, guilds with leaders and right-hands, and a shared history carry over. Each session is a fresh story in the same world.
- **Reputation system** — faction standing tracked per kingdom. Heroic deeds and crimes recorded.
- **SRD 5.1 content** — spells, races, classes, backgrounds, weapons all from the official SRD 5.1.

---

## Honest Caveats

- **Terminal UI only** — no graphics, no web interface.
- **Cloud-hosted AI** — all backends are cloud-based. You need internet and money for subscription/API key.
- **D&D 5e knowledge helps** — this is a rules-enforced game, not freeform improv.
- **Stories are session-based** — each session is a fresh narrative. But the world (kingdoms, rulers, guilds, history) and your character (inventory, gold, spells, reputation) persist across sessions, so continuity is smooth.

---

## Solo Developer

I'm the only person working on this. Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests are more than welcome.
